verdict: Organic traffic holding steady; paid ads remain off and need relaunch.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, no paid budget ran on Meta or Google, so all tracked engagement came from your Google Business Profile and direct website traffic. Your GBP logged 552 total actions this period — calls, direction requests, and site clicks — but the last two days of the window showed a sharp drop, with GBP activity down roughly 51% week-over-week; this is a confirmed dip, not a data blip. Website sessions held flat at around 338 per day, suggesting your direct and returning visitors are steady even as local search engagement slipped. Five milestones that were due by August 31st — including the live-cooking shoot, pre-launch gate, and funnel setup — are being resolved now, as they are the primary gate blocking paid ads from going back live. Once those are cleared, paid campaigns will relaunch and we'll have a full performance picture to report.
